rationale: The original short thesis remains fully intact: since entry, BIPC broke below the prior $41.38 session low to establish a new low at $41.27, and the subsequent reflex bounce to $41.50 failed well below the falling 5-minute 9-EMA ($41.58) before rotating back down to $41.38. Furthermore, the broader market risk-off environment has intensified (SPY down to -1.12%, VIXY up to +6.84%) while relative volume in BIPC has expanded to 3.50x, supporting further continuation toward the $41.10 target.
